subject: AWS Private Offer — pricing, term preference, and evidence request
messages:
From: Lindsey Park <lindsey@finovate.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Private Offer — pricing, term length, and evidence needed

Hi Sean,

We are evaluating Redwood via an AWS Private Offer and I need a couple of confirmations to move procurement forward:

- Pricing: can you provide committed (12-month) and month-to-month pricing tiers (per-token / per-embedding) and the delta between them?
- Term length: our FP&A prefers a 12-month commitment but legal may push for a shorter trial window — can you confirm if you support 12mo with prorated activation or a monthly usage plan?
- Approvals: what buyer approvals does AWS expect on their side for a Private Offer (procurement, legal, CFO)? Any gatekeepers we should know about?
- Security evidence: procurement needs SOC 2 Type II report, data residency statement, and a short list of the audit/logging artifacts you can provide.
- Co-sell: is co-sell enrollment required to get marketplace incentives or optional for us?

Timeline: they want to target signature by the end of the month if we can get materials. Can you send a starter terms doc and an evidence checklist?

Thanks,
Lindsey Park
Director of Procurement
Finovate Systems

[External]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey@finovate.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer — pricing, term length, and evidence needed

Hi Lindsey — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front and I attached a starter terms doc and an evidence bundle for your security team.

Summary:
- Pricing: we support both 12-month committed and usage-based month-to-month. Typical delta for committing is ~20–30% off list depending on TCV. I attached a simple price sheet in the terms PDF.
- Term: 12-month commitment available; we can also do month-to-month for pilots. For PO activation we can prorate start month if needed.
- Buyer approvals: AWS private offers typically require procurement + buyer admin + CFO signoff for larger deals. If you want co-sell credits, AWS requires co-sell registration which involves your account team (we can coordinate).
- Security evidence: attached Redwood_Security_Evidence.zip includes SOC 2 Type II redacted summary, data residency statement, and audit/logging capabilities overview. If your security team needs more granular logs we can arrange a narrow scope review under NDA.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_PrivateOffer_Terms_v1.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)], [Attachment: Redwood_Security_Evidence.zip (ZIP, 280 KB)]

Next steps: can you confirm whether procurement prefers a 12mo or monthly plan and whether we should route co-sell with AWS? I’ll loop Vanessa for marketplace activation timelines and Karthik for any contract redlines.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@finovate.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: RE: AWS Private Offer — pricing, term length, and evidence needed

Thanks Sean — a few clarifications from our side: 

1) We will aim for a 12-month commitment but legal wants a 30–60 day trial clause if we identify unmet requirements. Is that something you can accept?
2) SOC 2 Type II: we need the full report under NDA (summary not sufficient).
3) Data residency: we host production in us-west-2; please confirm where token processing and logs will reside.
4) Pricing breakout: procurement needs a simple table showing committed TCV discount bands and the per-month bill estimate at each tier.

Also, lead time: how long from signed PO to activation in AWS Marketplace? We have a close-of-business deadline on 28 Sep and need to know if that is achievable.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Finovate Systems

[External]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@finovate.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer — pricing, term length, and evidence needed

Hi Finovate team — Vanessa here, I run Marketplaces & Partner GTM for Redwood. Quick answers and a short activation plan below.

1) Trial clause: we can include a 30–60 day exit window negotiated as a limited trial addendum. Finance prefers a clear proration approach (we’ll supply language in the contract).
2) SOC 2 Type II: we can share the full report under NDA — please route an NDA to security@redwood.com and we’ll send the report within 24 business hours.
3) Data residency: token processing and transient KV cache live in the region where the instance is deployed — for AWS Private Offer on us-west-2 we will use us-west-2 compute and logs, with retention controls configurable per your security policy. I attached a short FAQ on marketplace co-sell and activation.
4) Activation lead time: standard workflow is 24–72 hours after AWS accepts the private offer and the PO is processed. For expedited cases we can request a 24–48 hour activation window from AWS but that requires seller-led escalations; we can support that once the PO is signed.

Pricing: Sean’s terms doc has the bands; we will also send a one-page committed vs usage comparison that maps to typical buyer approvals.

Attachments: [Attachment: Marketplace_CoSell_FAQ.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)]

Next steps: Sean — can you provide the one-page pricing table and create the HubSpot deal (if not already)? Procurement — please confirm NDA routing and whether you want co-sell enrollment (we recommend yes if you want AWS funding/credits).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Marketplaces & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
